meta.description: Flexible progress tracking with Open Badges - your journey, your pace.

step1.title: Define Your Goal
step1.description: Break big aims into small, meaningful steps. Start with what matters to you.

step2.title: Earn Badges
step2.description: Each step can earn you an Open Badge—digital credentials that prove your achievements. They're portable, verifiable, and yours to keep forever.

step3.title: Visualize Progress
step3.description: Choose timeline, grid, or tree views to see your patterns and progress.

step4.title: Pause — and Resume
step4.description: Pick up where you left off, pressure-free, with your context intact. Life happens—we get it.

step5.title: Share & Connect
step5.description: Export your badges, showcase your progress, and learn from others in the community.
